top_signals.title: Yen Surrenders Nearly Half Its Gains from US-Japan Intervention
top_signals.summary: The yen is heading into the end of the week having surrendered nearly half of its intervention-driven gains, fueling speculation among traders that authorities may step into the market again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Crypto market maker Wintermute launches US broker-dealer
top_signals.summary: Wintermute said the registration allows the firm to position itself for the growth of tokenized securities in the US.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Meta ordered to pay $567 million into abatement fund as remedy to child harms case in New Mexico
top_signals.summary: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $567 million into an abatement fund after a jury ruled the company violated the state’s unfair practices act.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
